title: RTG's Modpack
description: An experience arranged by RTG to enjoy an immersive and exciting experience.
body:
An experience arranged by RTG to enjoy an immersive and exciting experience.
This modpack helps enhance the Minecraft experience overall. 
Here is what this modpack offers:

## Immersion
This modpack also makes your Minecraft world really pop! It utilizes the [Complementary Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) to make this possible! 
We recommend changing the settings in Iris to how you prefer / works best with your PC.
This modpack also includes [sound ambiance](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) and [sound physics](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered), which can make your world feel more alive as you explore. 
Players' avatars also have 3D layers. 

## Multiplayer
Players have the ability to:
- [Voice chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) with friends
- View chatter's avatar
- Translate text

## Optimization
This modpack helps with
- Rendering Entities
- Resource reduction while in the background
- Game physics
- Mob AI
- Block Ticking

## Others
This modpack also adds
- Extra [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) features and options
- Extra entity features
- Extra configs

Here are some mods listed:
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)
- [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads)
- [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)
- Amongst others

Feel free to further explore these mods!
